CALM MONEY RESET
An ADHD-friendly budget & debt tracker from House of Calm
Setup guide for Google Sheets and Excel

Thank you for being here. This is one file, Calm-Money-Reset-Tracker.xlsx, with
12 gentle tabs plus a few helper tabs. It does the math for you. You just fill in
your numbers, at your own pace. This is not about restriction. It is about
awareness, and a little more calm around your money.


1. HOW TO OPEN THE FILE

Google Sheets (recommended, this tracker is built to feel at home here):
  1. Go to sheets.google.com and sign in.
  2. Click the folder icon (Open file picker), then the Upload tab.
  3. Upload Calm-Money-Reset-Tracker.xlsx.
  4. It opens automatically. To keep everything fully editable, click
     File > Save as Google Sheets and work in that copy going forward.
  A few soft colors and shading effects may look slightly different in Sheets
  than in Excel. All the formulas, dropdowns, and progress bars keep working.

Microsoft Excel:
  1. Double-click Calm-Money-Reset-Tracker.xlsx to open it (Excel 2016 or later,
     or Excel on the web via OneDrive).
  2. It works the same on the Excel mobile app. Turn your phone sideways for the
     wider tabs.


2. THE THREE-STEP START (that is really all it takes)

  1. NOTICE. Open the Transactions Log tab. Every time money comes in or goes
     out, add one line: the date, a category, and the amount. The Type fills in
     for you. This is the only place you type your numbers.
  2. GLANCE. Open the Dashboard tab. It shows your safe-to-spend for the week,
     days until your next bill, your low-spend streak, and simple progress bars.
     It updates the moment you add a transaction. Nothing to calculate.
  3. RESET. At the end of the month, visit the Monthly Reflection tab. Four kind
     questions, no scores. If the month went sideways, the Life Happens note is
     your permission to start fresh, guilt-free.


3. THE TABS

  Welcome ............... how it works, in plain language
  Dashboard ............. one calm glance: safe-to-spend, next bill, streak,
                          progress bars for debt and savings
  Flexible Income Budget  built for income that changes month to month
  Transactions Log ...... the one place you enter money in and money out
  Bank Import ........... paste a bank export, it suggests categories for you
  Doom Spending Log ..... log impulse buys and their triggers, no shame column
  Low-Spend Streaks ..... mark low-spend days, watch your streak grow
  Pause Before You Buy .. the 24-hour rule, made into a simple habit
  Bill Calendar ......... your bills laid out on the month they are due
  Savings & Debt Goal Tracker  progress bars for every goal and payoff
  Subscription Tracker .. see what you really pay each month
  Habit Tracker ......... a gentle daily-habit bonus
  Monthly Reflection .... four questions and a Life Happens reset note

  Helper tabs: Paycheck Budget (if your pay is regular), Example (a filled-in
  sample month), Notes FAQ, and Settings (the lists behind every dropdown).


4. A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

  * Colored cells are the ones you type in. Everything else calculates itself and
    is locked so a stray keystroke cannot break it. No password is needed to
    unlock a sheet if you ever want to (Review > Unprotect Sheet).
  * This tracker is undated. Start today, whatever day it is.
  * There are no red flags or alarms anywhere in here, on purpose. Noticing is
    the whole win.
  * Stuck? Open the Example tab and compare. It shows a working month.

With care,
House of Calm
